body.name: \(B_P(y)\)
body.construction: \(B_P(y):=\operatorname{lexmin}\arg\min\{\sum_{x\in B}\Delta_x(y):B\subseteq\mathcal X_m,\ |B|\le m/2\}\). Equivalently, \(B_P(y)\) contains up to \(m/2\) strictly negative contrasts, ordered from smallest upward, with lexicographic resolution of equal contrasts.
